subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should this core-internal retry callback permanently retain `attempt` as a deprecated key-index alias, or should all supported callers move to the explicit `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` fields?
rationale: The branch claims plugin compatibility, while repository policy routes plugin consumers through SDK seams and discourages internal compatibility aliases without a demonstrated shipped public contract.

options.title: Use canonical explicit fields
options.body: Remove the ambiguous alias, expose only `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber`, and migrate every supported internal caller and test in this PR.

options.title: Keep a documented compatibility alias
options.body: Retain `attempt` only after identifying the shipped external contract, documenting its semantics and removal plan, and adding focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Pause the contract expansion
options.body: Leave the existing callback unchanged until a concrete supported consumer demonstrates a need for additional retry metadata.

recommendation.title: Use canonical explicit fields
recommendation.body: Remove the ambiguous alias, expose only `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber`, and migrate every supported internal caller and test in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The original key-rotation helper and callback contract date to this person's feature commit.
